sections.content: CSS affects performance through: selector matching cost (avoid deep descendant chains), properties that trigger layout (width, top) vs paint (color) vs composite (transform, opacity), and oversized stylesheets.
Fast properties to animate: transform and opacity only — they skip layout and paint. content-visibility: auto skips rendering off-screen sections entirely.
Key points: will-change hints the compositor, avoid animating box-shadow/filters on large areas, and unused CSS still costs parse time.
